title: Serious Sam Fusion 2017
description: Serious Sam Fusion 2017 dedicated server (Steam app 564390, 64-bit) - one UDP port; it hosts the Serious Sam games Fusion includes. Pick the game mode below; everything else is a Serious Engine setting you can add to its arguments in config.json as +name value (e.g. +level "<path>"), or put in a Lua script it runs with +exec. It has no remote console ServerDeck speaks or Steam query it uses, so ServerDeck shows it online by its port, can't list or warn players, and stops it with Ctrl+C (Croteam's way). Up to 16 players. About 1-2 GB of RAM.

fields.label: Game mode
fields.help: e.g. Cooperative, Deathmatch, TeamDeathmatch, CaptureTheFlag, LastManStanding, InstantKill, MyBurden, TeamSurvival, BeastHunt

fields.label: Rcon password
fields.help: for Croteam's own rcon tool; left empty, a random one is made
